grades: Entering grades 10 to 12 in Fall 2027 (or recent graduates)
name: High School Engineering Institute (HSEI) at Michigan State University
org: Michigan State University College of Engineering
what_you_do: A week on campus living in the dorms. Each day you learn about an engineering major with faculty and students, do hands-on team projects and tour research labs.
who_can_apply: Co-ed. Open to U.S. and international students entering grades 10 to 12 in Fall 2027. You need a GPA of 3.0 or better in engineering core courses (math, sciences, technology). A transcript is required.
pay_detail: $1,199 program fee (covers activities, room and board). MSU says it offers no scholarships for its pre-college programs.
duration: One week, residential. Four sessions: June 13 to 17, June 20 to 24, June 27 to July 1, July 11 to 15
deadline_text: Applications open mid-December 2026. Deadlines by session: Session 1 June 4, Session 2 June 11, Session 3 June 18, Session 4 July 2. The page does not print the year; it is the cycle for students entering grades 10 to 12 in Fall 2027.
how_to_apply: Send an online application with your transcript. Payment by credit card is the last step. It is required before MSU reviews the application. If you are not accepted, the fee is refunded minus a $25 processing fee.
notes: Residential. Mentors supervise students in the dorms, and students cannot leave campus. Contact: future-engineer@egr.msu.edu or 517-353-7282 (from the college page). Check the year of the session dates against the application page when it opens.
